instruction: Go directly to the pillow near the dining table, entering at least three rooms between the start and that pillow. From there, go directly to the decorative plant that is in the toilet room and has a cabinet nearby, preferably avoiding the door between the hallway and the laundryroom/mudroom from the start until reaching the decorative plant. Finally, go directly to the bed farthest from the clothes hanger.
